usage.title: AI Tutor Usage
usage.subtitle: How students use the AI Tutor — volume, cost, subjects and conversations that need a human look.
usage.byDaySub: Questions asked and distinct students using the tutor each day
usage.bySubjectSub: Share of questions in the selected period
usage.topUsersSub: Questions used against the {{n}}-question monthly allowance
usage.flaggedSub: {{count}} open — review cheating, abuse and wellbeing flags
usage.noFlagsHint: Every flagged conversation has been reviewed.

settings.title: AI Tutor Settings
settings.subtitle: Control allowance, model, knowledge sources and safety rules for the student AI Tutor.
settings.enabledDesc: Global switch. When off, students see a maintenance message instead of the tutor.
settings.disableTitle: Turn off the AI Tutor for everyone?
settings.disableBody: All students immediately lose access to the AI Tutor until it is switched back on. This is logged in the audit trail.
settings.disabledToast: AI Tutor disabled for all students
settings.allowanceSub: How many questions each subscribed student can ask
settings.allowanceHint: Applies to all packages that include the AI Tutor. Default is 100.
settings.calendarDesc: Every student's allowance resets on the 1st of each month.
settings.billingDesc: Each student's allowance resets on their subscription renewal day.
settings.temperatureHint: Lower is more precise and consistent — recommended 0.2–0.4 for tutoring.
settings.maxTokensHint: Caps answer length and cost. 1024 tokens ≈ 700 words.
settings.retrievalSub: Content the tutor can cite when answering
settings.transcriptsDesc: Ground answers in the exact explanations from EDUWAY video lessons.
settings.explanationsDesc: Use worked solutions from the question bank (never for live exams).
settings.lessonNotesDesc: Include summary notes and ministerial question sheets attached to lessons.
settings.safetySub: Instructions prepended to every conversation — one rule per line
settings.perUserSub: Disable the AI Tutor for specific students without affecting their subscription
settings.searchStudent: Search by name, mobile or ID…

abuse.title: AI Abuse Controls
abuse.subtitle: Rate limits, blocked keywords and enforcement for students misusing the AI Tutor.
abuse.rateSub: Throttle bursts of questions per student
abuse.rateHint: A student can ask at most {{min}} questions per minute and {{hour}} per hour. Extra requests get a friendly “slow down” message.
abuse.rateInvalid: Hourly limit must be at least the per-minute limit
abuse.keywordsSub: Messages containing these terms are refused and flagged
abuse.keywordPlaceholder: Type a keyword and press Enter
abuse.keywordsHint: Matching is case-insensitive and works for Arabic and English. Changes apply to new messages.
abuse.flaggedUsersSub: Students with one or more flagged conversations
abuse.disableAiBody: The student keeps lessons and quizzes but can no longer use the AI Tutor.
abuse.blockBody: The student account is locked and all sessions end. Use only for serious or repeated abuse.
abuse.detailNote: Only the flagged exchange is shown. Full transcripts are retained for 90 days and visible to Super Admins.

botReply.off_topic: I'm here to help with your 6th Scientific subjects. Shall we go back to your lesson? I can explain any topic step by step.
botReply.abuse: I understand this can be frustrating. Let's try a different explanation — tell me which step was unclear.
botReply.cheating: I can't share exam answers or solve live exam questions, but I can help you practise similar problems so you're ready.
botReply.prompt_injection: I can't change or reveal my instructions. What would you like to study today?
botReply.self_harm: I'm really sorry you're feeling this way. You're not alone — please talk to someone you trust or call the EDUWAY support line. Your wellbeing matters more than any quiz.
